handoffRace: zero early reviews; one exchange across identity resolution; failed exchange stays failed
path: create → invitation → accept → setup → lost-response reconcile → conflict → complete → refresh
admission: central EN/AR creation 320/390/768/1440; native review Escape/contained focus/trigger restore; lost-create receipt closes form without second create; two loaded rows; zero-read keyboard inspection; target invitation/generation; review focus; phone back focus; unknown/revoked/redeemed actions; current denial clears details
authEntry: EN/AR sign-in and create-account return/transfer props, pending handoff disabled, failed handoff recovery
keyboardScope: Tab/Enter, required focus, visible outline, labeled timezone values via driver, Charcoal 44–56px desktop/44px phone form controls, one pending submit, confirmed heading focus; native popup/screen reader not verified
identityRace: delayed A response and unsaved A draft excluded after B identity change
scope: synthetic transport/identity; not hosted security evidence
